question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: a JSON-RPC tools/call of firecrawl_scrape with arguments url https://example.com and formats [markdown], Content-Type application/json, Accept application/json and text/event-stream, after an initialize on the same endpoint answered 200

decoded.result: a JSON-RPC result on an SSE data line whose content text reads: Anonymous keyless access is unavailable for this request. Fix: Create an API key at the vendor's app, then send it as an authorization header on https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp and start a new session. (The refusal names the header literally; it is paraphrased here because the registry's validator reads that literal as a credential.)
decoded.structuredContent: code KEYLESS_ACCESS_NOT_AVAILABLE, auth_mode keyless, with a request_id
decoded.preceding-initialize: 200, serverInfo firecrawl-fastmcp 3.25.2, instructions naming firecrawl_search, firecrawl_scrape and firecrawl_parse as the keyless surface
decoded.preceding-tools-list: 200, exactly three tools: firecrawl_scrape, firecrawl_search, firecrawl_parse

finding: The vendor's documented keyless MCP tier answers the handshake and lists its three keyless tools to a caller with no credential, and then refuses the call. The refusal is not an HTTP status: the response is 200 and the refusal is a JSON-RPC result carrying code KEYLESS_ACCESS_NOT_AVAILABLE and auth_mode keyless, so a checker reading status lines sees a success. The same refusal, in the same words, was measured on 2026-09-09; the server version moved from 3.24.1 to 3.25.2 between the two readings. Nothing here measures what the tier does from a residential address, which is the case the vendor's rate-limit page describes.

reproducibility.command: curl -sS -X POST https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"probe","version":"1.0"}}}' && curl -sS -X POST https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"firecrawl_scrape","arguments":{"url":"https://example.com","formats":["markdown"]}}}'
